crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, roughly triangular reddish-brown patch located at the dorsal apex of the crown and nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct and linear color boundary separating the reddish-brown crown from the greyish mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast transverse white rectangular spotting on a dark black ground color on the tail feathers.
